items.title: Phil Woods — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Jimmy Knepper and Jerry Dodgion had a room together... We all had rooms with balconies... Jimmy Knepper and Jerry Dodgion had a room together and they threw a party.

ctx.x: Oh, yes. Well, here we are again with Phil Woods, June 23rd, 2010.
Third day of summer. [NM]: … as part of the Smithsonian. Yes, third day of summer …
